scope: Two sequential real Kokoro file-synthesis requests through the reusable local-TTS worker, followed by idle-process release
claim_boundary: Developer-machine file synthesis and process-lifetime evidence only; no claim of audible quality, speaker compatibility, universal latency, or Pocket TTS performance
limitations: Cold latency depends on host load, storage cache, model availability, and model-download state.
The warm measurement covers one immediate follow-up within the bounded worker lifetime.
Audio was verified as non-empty WAV output, not assessed by a human listener in this run.
The worker temporarily consumes model memory while active; isolation ensures those libraries are not retained by the long-lived daemon.
